fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. “About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God…” (Acts 16:25) Silas is Paul's traveling partner. The two of them are in the inner cell with their feet in the stocks after a beating (Acts 16:23-24). That's not what I would be doing at midnight.

Yes, friend. “…he and all his household rejoiced that they had come to believe in God.” (Acts 16:34) The jailer brought Paul and Silas into his home. He set a meal before them. I think that's a happy house, friend.
